cohort: All admissions in the obstetrics and gynaecology wards of four primary healthcare centres and one state hospital in three Payams of Torit County, South Sudan in 2015
finding: The met need for EmOC in Torit County was low at 65.13%, with a disparity between urban and rural areas, and 35% of women with major obstetric complications not accessing care.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were one of the most common interventions performed (32.7%).
